d: Long, flowing orchid-pink hair with straight bangs and animal ears at the crown frames a youthful, mature face with narrow, bright blue eyes. The slim build is dressed in a white cleavage-baring top, a short dark navy pleated skirt, and a long light-blue oversized jacket featuring various gaming logos and pink trim, paired with black thigh-high stockings adorned with gold paw prints and white sneakers with pink accents. Accessories include a black headset around the neck, a small black crossbody bag, and a large black equipment case carried on the back.
